header.description: Receive events from a ZapZap instance (messages, connection, etc) via webhook

instanceId.description: WhatsApp instance ID whose webhook will be registered (the UUID from creating or listing instances)

events.description: Events that start the workflow. Empty = core events (messages, connection, status).

presence.description: Online, offline and typing. High volume.

manualSetup.description: By default the webhook is registered and removed automatically. Turn this on only if you prefer to point the webhook yourself, in the panel or via the API.
